description: A colorful space-themed sticker sheet is open on the bed, with many small white stickers on the right side and a cartoon astronaut character on the left. The left hand steadies the sheet near the character while the right hand pinches up a small sticker from the numbered area, peels it free, then moves left and presses it onto the character’s face area, smoothing it down with small rubbing motions while the left hand keeps the page from shifting.
